title: console: a member without setup.access opens Setup's item pages by direct URL — the permission-set and position editors render under another app's chrome, and the holders section draws its refused read as "No users assigned yet"
body:
Filing gate ①: a product defect, user-visible, with a named landing point. **reach:** browser, measured on two builds (below).

**Reader who acts:** objectui triage. The landing is the console's Setup routing in `@object-ui/app-shell`: the `/apps/setup/...` routes and the app access verdict that `AppContent` renders. A second, smaller landing is `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/AssignedUsersSection.tsx`'s read-failure state. Filed by `domain:ui` seat 3 (`session_01Vk15bz8xHtKGUfXfCm16h4`) from its browser check of PR objectui#12685 (objectui#12082). Neither half is in that PR's diff: both builds read the same. ⛔ Not a claim.

## Environment
- Backend: objectstack `66d456d01` `examples/app-crm`, `objectstack dev --seed-admin --fresh` (`Tenancy: single`).
- Consoles: objectui `main` `efa9cb4` and the PR head `7e9eed3`, Vite dev, 1280 × 900.
- Principal: a plain member, `member12685@example.com`, created by the platform admin (`POST /api/v1/auth/admin/create-user` → 200), signed in, password changed. `GET /api/v1/auth/me/permissions` → `permissionSets: ["member_default"]`, `systemPermissions: []`, so no `setup.access`.

## Reproduction (the same on both builds)
1. As the member, open `/apps/setup`. It lands on `/apps/setup/dashboard/pipeline_dashboard`, under the CRM app's chrome, with no Setup sidebar entries. The dashboard's tiles read "You don't have access".
2. Open `/apps/setup/metadata/permission?scope=environment`. The permission-set list renders and names the environment's sets (`crm_sales_user` among them).
3. Open `/apps/setup/metadata/permission/crm_sales_user?scope=environment`. The permission-set editor (the matrix) renders, and its Assigned Users section reads "0" and "No users assigned yet". The section's own read, `GET /api/v1/data/sys_user_permission_set`, answered **403**, so the empty claim is false: the set has one direct holder.
4. Open `/apps/setup/metadata/position/sales_rep?scope=environment`. The position editor renders with a "Pending changes — save lives in a draft" banner. Its holders section shows the 403 as an alert ("You do not have permission to perform this action…") above "Nobody holds this position yet."
5. Network on these pages: 24 × 403 `POST /api/v1/analytics/dataset/query`, 2 × 403 `sys_metadata_activation`, 403 `GET /api/v1/meta/_drafts`, and 403 on both assignment objects' reads. No page error.

The server refuses every read that matters. The holders and the matrix's grants do not leak; the catalog list of step 2 does render. So this is a wrong screen, not an access hole.

**Expected:**
- A caller the Setup app refuses (`setup.access` absent) gets the access-denied verdict on every `/apps/setup/...` route, as on the app itself, instead of Setup's editors under another app's chrome. objectui#12285 is a different shape: the package-id URL showing "can't be opened". This card is the by-name route rendering its pages.
- A holders section whose read is refused says so, as `PositionHoldersSection` does, and as objectui#5169 settled for the metadata Audit tab (a failed read is not an empty one). It does not say "No users assigned yet".

## Evidence
The seat holds screenshots locally (not attached): `shot-c-main-setup-home`, `shot-c-main-permsets-list`, `shot-c-main-permset-section` and `shot-c-main-position-section`, plus the same four on the PR build. The request logs and `me/permissions` captures sit beside them. The readings above are from the run's JSON records.

**Dedupe** (objectui, open and closed): REST list of every `domain:ui` card, paged explicitly, 2392 rows, grepped:
- `setup.access`: 5 hits, other subjects (#12475, #12341, #12112, #9623, #6285);
- `deep link`: 14 hits, other subjects (#12520 and #12496 are metadata-admin, but about Design and `?tab=`);
- `No users assigned`: 0;
- `AssignedUsersSection`: 3 hits, other subjects (#11903, #6726, #5945);
- positive control `setup`: 98 hits.

Dedupe words: member opens Setup by direct URL, Setup routes skip app access verdict, metadata admin pages render without setup.access, holders section 403 shown as empty.
